sources.title: A violation of global symmetries from replica wormholes and the fate of black hole remnants

evidence.text: Optimize reconstruction using the charged-state Gram matrix M and overlap vector V. Evaluate VMⁿV by replica geometries and continue to n=−1. JT planar resummation uses a resolvent and Schwinger–Dyson equation, simplifying in a microcanonical window.

sources.title: Wet Hair: Global Symmetries in Entanglement Islands

evidence.text: Can continuous global symmetries consistently act on particles in entanglement islands, and do such examples support a connection between unitarity and the absence of global symmetries in quantum gravity?

sources.title: Discrete gauge symmetry in continuum theories

evidence.text: Can discrete symmetries in continuum low-energy theories have a local gauge origin, and can that origin enforce conservation and produce observable black-hole hair despite the absence of a low-energy gauge potential?

sources.title: Approximate Symmetries and Gravity

evidence.text: How exact can emergent global symmetries be in gravitational EFTs, and can thermal black-hole charge loss quantitatively bound local symmetry violation?

sources.title: Black hole entropy as entanglement entropy: A Holographic derivation

evidence.text: Can black hole entropy be identified entirely with quantum-field entanglement across the horizon while accounting for ultraviolet dependence, the species problem, and gravitational backreaction?

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Which mechanisms prevent continuous generalized global symmetries from producing black-hole remnant problems, especially when infrared effects suppress the charged configurations that would ordinarily break the symmetry?

sources.title: The entropy of Hawking radiation

evidence.text: How can gravitational fine-grained entropy methods compute Hawking-radiation entropy consistently with unitary evaporation, despite the growing entropy obtained from the semiclassical radiation state?

sources.title: Skyrmion Black Hole Hair: Conservation of Baryon Number by Black Holes and Observable Manifestations

evidence.text: Does classical skyrmion hair undermine semiclassical evaporation arguments against baryon-number conservation, and how would such hair affect scalar-wave scattering?

sources.title: Replica Wormholes and the Entropy of Hawking Radiation

evidence.text: Can the gravitational replica path integral directly yield a radiation entropy compatible with unitarity and the island rule, without higher-dimensional holographic input?

sources.title: Kac-Moody instantons in space-time foam as an alternative solution to the black hole information paradox

evidence.text: Can self-dual Yang–Mills and gravitational instantons on space-time foam furnish Kac–Moody quantum hairs that encode black hole information?

sources.title: Quantum-Corrected Black Holes in Higher Dimensions: From Gravitational Collapse to Remnants, WGC-Like Behavior and Accretion Signatures

evidence.text: How do loop-quantum-cosmology corrections to higher-dimensional dust collapse affect black-hole remnants, effective extremality ratios, thermodynamic response and steady accretion observables?

sources.title: A universal formula for the density of states in theories with finite-group symmetry

evidence.text: At fixed energy, how are black hole microstates distributed among irreducible representations of a finite long-range gauge group G? Can the resulting distribution also describe sufficiently high-energy states in QFTs with finite global symmetry?

sources.title: Statistical hair on black holes

evidence.text: Can an extremal black hole's quantum microstate be measured in the regime with an event horizon, despite the apparent semiclassical no-hair obstruction?

sources.title: Black hole-de Sitter space as the fastest transmitter and receiver

evidence.text: Can quantum speed limits and maximal entropy-transfer bounds regulate late black-hole evaporation, relate information flow to cosmic censorship, and constrain how de Sitter expansion admits modes into an EFT?

sources.title: Global symmetry, Euclidean gravity, and the black hole information problem

evidence.text: Can assumptions behind a unitary black-hole Page curve exclude global symmetries beyond AdS/CFT, and what connects the success of Euclidean gravitational entropy calculations to holographic UV completion?

sources.title: Hawking radiation as tunneling

evidence.text: Can Hawking emission be derived directly as horizon tunneling while enforcing energy conservation, and how does the resulting emission law depart from thermality?

sources.title: Unitary S Matrices With Long-Range Correlations and the Quantum Black Hole

evidence.text: Can long-range correlations between incoming and outgoing black-hole states be incorporated into a unitary S matrix at intermediate evaporation stages, and what changes to causality and complementarity would this require?

sources.title: Signatures of global symmetry violation in relative entropies and replica wormholes

evidence.text: Can global symmetry violation be quantified using only part of the Hawking radiation, before the endpoint of evaporation, despite symmetry-violating correlators being nonperturbatively small?

sources.title: Page curve and symmetries

evidence.text: How do conserved charges and explicit charge violation modify Page curves and symmetry-resolved entropies in a random qubit evaporation model, and what conditional lessons might this provide about black-hole evaporation and symmetries?

sources.title: A Few words on entropy, thermodynamics, and horizons

evidence.text: Are proposed Bekenstein and holographic entropy bounds necessary for semiclassical black-hole thermodynamics, and how does observer-dependent entropy flux resolve apparent generalized-second-law violations?

sources.title: Spacetime has a “thickness”

evidence.text: If black-hole information returns in Hawking radiation and leading-order causality holds in gently curved spacetime, what can make an energetic infalling shell depart from semiclassical evolution before its information becomes trapped?

sources.title: Black holes and entropy

evidence.text: What minimum information disappears from exterior access when a particle is swallowed, and can that minimum calibrate black-hole entropy?

sources.title: Hints of gravitational ergodicity: Berry’s ensemble and the universality of the semi-classical Page curve

evidence.text: Can an ensemble-averaged semiclassical calculation recover a unitarity-compatible Page curve within a single unitary theory, with the ensemble representing epoch time averages rather than distinct microscopic theories?

sources.title: Cool horizons for entangled black holes

evidence.text: How does entanglement determine Einstein–Rosen bridges and black-hole interiors, and does entanglement with a distant system require a firewall? The paper tests AMPS/AMPSS reasoning in two-sided black-hole models and proposes extensions to evaporating holes.

sources.title: Les Houches lectures on black holes

evidence.text: How can black-hole formation and evaporation be reconciled with quantum superposition, energy conservation and unitarity? The lectures use two-dimensional models to examine semiclassical evaporation and constrain possible descriptions beyond its endpoint.

sources.title: The entropy of bulk quantum fields and the entanglement wedge of an evaporating black hole

evidence.text: Can bulk quantum entropy significantly displace quantum extremal surfaces during black-hole evaporation, and can the resulting entanglement wedge reproduce the Page curve and Hayden-Preskill information-recovery delay?

sources.title: Unrecognizable black holes in two-dimensions

evidence.text: Does the CGHS model's nonlinear global symmetry survive quantization together with BRST symmetry, and does its survival prevent the model's Weyl-invariant matter from recognizing a black-hole background or producing radiation?

sources.title: Information in black hole radiation

evidence.text: Can perturbative calculations exclude gradual information recovery in black-hole radiation if unitary evaporation encodes information in exponentially small corrections or widely distributed correlations?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Can low-curvature Hamiltonian evolution on nice slices describe an entire unitary evaporation? The reviewed paradox contrasts the entropy increase predicted by independent interior and exterior degrees of freedom with the shrinking information capacity assigned to the hole.

sources.title: The Page curve of Hawking radiation from semiclassical geometry

evidence.text: Can semiclassical geometry directly produce the Page curve of Hawking radiation, without merely inferring it from purity of the combined black hole–radiation state, and what entropy prescription accounts for interior islands?

sources.title: Distinguishing Schwinger effect from Hawking radiation in Reissner-Nordström black holes via entanglement

evidence.text: Can entanglement entropy distinguish Schwinger pair production from Hawking radiation in charged black holes when their contributions are intertwined in the radiation spectrum?

sources.title: Black Hole as a Quantum Field Configuration

evidence.text: Can semiclassical gravity and quantum matter provide a self-consistent evaporating black-hole interior, explain its supporting pressure and energy loss, and reproduce the entropy area law by counting field configurations?

sources.title: Jerusalem Lectures on Black Holes and Quantum Information

evidence.text: How can black-hole evaporation preserve quantum information while allowing a smooth experience for an infalling observer, and how do quantum information theory and holography sharpen this problem?

sources.title: Black Hole's 1/N Hair

evidence.text: Within the proposed graviton-condensate description, do finite-occupation quantum effects produce detectable black-hole hair for nongauged conserved charges, and do they invalidate the usual black-hole argument against continuous global symmetries?

sources.title: Infinite Black Hole Entropies at Infinite Distances and Tower of States

evidence.text: Can a black hole with exponentially many nearly degenerate microstates develop a parametrically light set of excitations as entropy grows? The appendix studies this question using N-portrait assumptions and a simplified finite-factor model.

sources.title: Swift Memory Burden in Merging Black Holes: how information load affects black hole's classical dynamics

evidence.text: Can information stored in a black hole rapidly affect its response to classical perturbations, including mergers, and produce observable gravitational-wave signatures without waiting for substantial Hawking evaporation?

destinations.title: Can a collapsing object bounce from a black-hole-like trapped phase into an outgoing white-hole phase while satisfying Einstein's equations outside a finite quantum region, and can small exterior quantum effects accumulate long enough to permit this transition?

Can quantum extremal surfaces and entanglement wedge reconstruction explain the Page curve, information recovery and a smooth evaporating horizon while retaining semiclassical Hawking entanglement? How does recovery depend on knowledge of the initial state?

Can gravitational replica wormholes justify the island prescription and Page curve, directly explain reconstruction of black-hole interior operators from radiation, and clarify the ensemble averaging implicit in these calculations?

Can extended, compression-resistant virtual configurations in the quantum-gravity vacuum resolve black-hole information loss, unbounded interior entropy, and the difference between black-hole and cosmological horizons while retaining leading-order causality?

Can stored information be dynamically rewritten between memory sectors to overcome memory burden, on what timescale, and what might the resulting slowdown imply for black-hole evaporation and small primordial black holes?

Do replica wormholes violate global-charge conservation even when the effective Lagrangian preserves the symmetry, and does the resulting nonorthogonality of charged states remove the excessive-degeneracy objection to black-hole remnants?

Can Maxwell soft hair be described quantitatively as boundary edge modes, and can measurements of those modes compete with Hawking entanglement production to produce a Page-like curve for black-hole entropy?

Can semiclassical JT black-hole evaporation with backreaction, supplemented by an effective dual-CFT description of entanglement, yield a regular endpoint and a radiation Page curve consistent with unitarity?

Can charge probabilities supply a replica-free lower bound on Hawking-radiation entropy that conflicts with entropy saturation? How do global symmetry, gauging, and replica-wormhole holonomies affect that conflict and constrain two-dimensional couplings?
Can FRG decoupling determine a physically motivated scale identification and qualitative quantum corrections to black holes throughout collapse, a static endpoint, and evaporation?

Can unitarity, a universal Bekenstein information-transfer bound and cosmic censorship constrain the late semiclassical evaporation of a black hole, potentially changing its mass-loss law before quantum gravity becomes important?
Can exponential suppression of trans-Planckian interactions in a string-inspired nonlocal field theory change Hawking radiation, particularly after the scrambling time?

Can islands associated with high-angular-momentum Hawking modes extend parametrically beyond the stretched horizon, and can asymptotic observers probe the resulting conflict with semiclassical locality?

How does stored information resist decay in enhanced-memory systems, how does this mechanism operate in solitons and proposed microscopic black-hole descriptions, and what mass distributions and dark-matter implications might follow for PBHs?
Can trans-Planckian effects suppress the magnitude of Hawking radiation near the scrambling time, leaving a macroscopic black hole that retains information and avoids the usual evaporation paradox?

Can a non-isometric encoding of charged black-hole interior states produce global-symmetry violation in radiation while reproducing a quantum-extremal-surface entropy formula, and how can relative entropies quantify that violation?

If Hawking emission carries a sufficiently massive charged black hole past extremality, what happens to the matter that formed it, and could the resulting remnant provide a semiclassical setting for studying information loss?

Does a specified gravitational completion of CGHS radiation encode its global state near past null-boundary endpoints, and can right-radiation island reconstruction coexist with exact left/right radiative commutativity?
Can black-hole formation and evaporation admit a unitary scattering matrix with finite entropy and a discrete spectrum, and what horizon degrees of freedom would implement it?
Can the AMNV 'gravity as the weakest force' conjectures supply a semiclassical mechanism that slows black-hole evaporation before the Planck scale, allowing a smooth transition to quantum gravity?

Could black-hole evaporation preserve information through remnants whose size and mass increase with their information content, avoiding the difficulties of arbitrarily information-rich Planck-sized remnants?

Can information-storing black-hole remnants coexist with a finite asymptotic Newton constant once their exact-equilibrium Rindler atmosphere is included, independently of divergent pair-production rates?

Can simply connected spacetime foam be interpreted as virtual black-hole loops, and does particle scattering from these fluctuations produce a nonfactorizing superscattering operator, observable coherence loss, or an endpoint for black-hole evaporation?
Does quantum matter on a classical collapse spacetime produce persistent black-hole emission, and what does that imply for temperature, horizon-area decrease, thermodynamics and evaporation?
